source.title: Red Hat Secure Software Development Lifecycle
source.applicability: Internal SDLC process addressing risk assessment, vulnerability management, and security testing protocols for enterprise open source software development. Provides structured framework for dependency and secrets handling.

passages.locator: Red Hat Secure Development Lifecycle section
passages.text:
Red Hat maintains a software development lifecycle (SDLC) process that addresses risk assessment, vulnerability assessment, and security testing protocols of Red Hat software. Red Hat's SDLC process follows the 
NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework
, conducting security reviews related to secure architecture, secure pipeline, threat modeling, Static and Dynamic Application Security Testing, antimalware scanning,  penetration testing, and incident
